trigger: source-clock audit found that packaged US level history cannot reproduce panel daily US features on a minority of dates
purpose: attribute the already-frozen C1-vs-C0 holdout error difference to rows whose panel US features are or are not exactly reproducible from the packaged US levels; do not fit or select a new policy

alignment_definition.nasdaq_exact: panel us_nasdaq equals pct change of last packaged nonmissing NASDAQ level strictly before target China day versus the previous packaged NASDAQ level, abs tolerance 1e-10
alignment_definition.vix_exact: panel us_vix_chg equals pct change of last packaged nonmissing VIX level strictly before target China day versus the previous packaged VIX level, abs tolerance 1e-10
alignment_definition.mismatch: not both_exact; indicates packaged raw level history is insufficient to reconstruct at least one panel feature

diagnostics: holdout row counts exact vs mismatch by 2019 and 2020
C1 minus C0 summed squared-error improvement on exact vs mismatch rows
positive SSE-improvement concentration on mismatch rows
IC and sign-hit of the two already-frozen predictions within exact and mismatch subsets
top mismatch rows by absolute C1-vs-C0 squared-error contribution
interpretation_rule: This is forensic attribution only. A concentration of C1 gain on mismatch rows invalidates the clean unabsorbed-information interpretation; a gain on exact rows may remain descriptive but cannot rescue v1 as validated because the C1 feature itself was constructed from an incomplete source calendar.
